title: Medical English 06-07
category: Medical & Dental Questions > Medical English Question

questions.explanation: এ বাক্যের subject হচ্ছে over-eating যেটা singular. So, verb ও singular হবে, অর্থাৎ, are না হয়ে is হবে।

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect speech: He asked me, 'Are you happy in your new job?'
options: He asked me if I was happy in my new job
He asked me whether I am happy in my new job
He asked me if I had been happy in my new job
He asked me if I have been happy in my new job
questions.explanation: Grammar এর নিয়মানুযায়ী, Option (A) ই সঠিক।

questions.question: Most appropriate translation of the sentence: 'সূর্য অস্ত যাবার পূর্বে আমরা কাজ করেছিলাম।'
options: We had worked before the sunset
We would have been working before the sunset
We have been working before the sunset
We had been working before the sunset
questions.explanation: Before-এর পূর্বে past perfect এবং পরে noun phrase হয়।

questions.question: Which would be an acceptable synonym of the word 'hospitality'?
questions.explanation: Hospitality শব্দের অর্থ আতিথেয়তা। এর সমার্থক শব্দ হবে welcome| Pharmacy অর্থ ঔষধালয়; hospital অর্থ হাসপাতাল; sick অর্থ অসুস্থ।

questions.question: Hold water' means-
options: Keep water for the dry season

questions.question: The correct passive form of 'Take care of your health' is-
options: Let your health be taken care of
Let your health taken care of
Health is taken care by you.
questions.explanation: Imperative Sentence-এর passive structure হচ্ছে Let + object + be + V3 + ex.

questions.question: If restated, the sentence that would best replace- 'As a conductor of heat and electricity, aluminium exceeds all metals except silver and gold'
options: Silver and gold are better conductors of heat and electricity than aluminium
Aluminium is better conductor of heat and electricity than silver and gold
With the exception of aluminium, silver and gold are better than any other metal as conductors of heat and electricity.
Silver and gold are exceeded only by aluminium as deconductors of heat and electricity
questions.explanation: তাপ ও বিদ্যুৎ পরিবাহী হিসেবে অ্যালুমিনিয়াম, সোনা এবং রূপা বাদে, সব ধাতুর চেয়ে ভাল। অর্থাৎ, সোনা ও রূপা পরিবাহী হিসেবে অ্যালুমিনিয়ামের চেয়ে ভাল।

questions.question: The tree has been blown ________ by the strong wind.
questions.explanation: Blow away অর্থ (বাতাসে/ ঝড়ে) উড়িয়ে নিয়ে যাওয়া। Blow out নেভানো; blow off নির্গত হওয়া; blow up - বিস্ফোরিত হওয়া।

questions.question: A person whose 'head' is in the 'clouds' is-
questions.explanation: Whose head is in the clouds অর্থ দিবা-স্বপ্নচারী অর্থাৎ, day dreamer.

questions.question: Which sentence would be the most appropriate continuation of 'We didn't want to wake any body up as?'
options: we were going all the shops were shut
we went for a walk by the sea
questions.explanation: we went for a walk by the sea

questions.question: 'He died...accident.'
questions.explanation: দুর্ঘটনায় মারা গেলে die by হয়। Die for দেশের জন্য মৃত্যুবরণ করা; die of রোগে মারা যাওয়া
